ai_advisor.executive_summary: Three issues found for Deployment sandbox-kata/target-kata: service account token automounting, writable root filesystem, and setuid/setgid binaries in the image. Risk band: high (total 14).

prioritized_groups.title: Prevent credential exposure
prioritized_groups.rationale: Service account tokens in pods increase risk of cluster compromise; high severity and blast radius.

item_advice.explanation: Pod has an automounted service account token available inside the container.
item_advice.operator_impact: Disabling automount will break any in-pod code that calls the Kubernetes API using the token.
item_advice.validation_advice: Search container images and code for Kubernetes client usage; check for dependencies (e.g., leader election, controllers). Test in staging by setting automountServiceAccountToken: false on the PodSpec.
item_advice.ordering_reason: Mitigates high-risk credential exposure quickly with minimal infra changes once validated.

item_advice.explanation: Container root filesystem is writable, allowing modification of binaries/config and persistence of changes.
item_advice.operator_impact: Setting readOnlyRootFilesystem may break applications that write to /tmp, /var, /etc or application-specific paths.
item_advice.validation_advice: Identify writable paths at runtime (strace or filesystem checks), relocate writable data to emptyDir or persistent volumes, then test enabling readOnlyRootFilesystem in staging.
item_advice.ordering_reason: Reduces attack surface broadly but requires verifying and remediating legitimate writable paths first.

item_advice.explanation: Image contains setuid/setgid binaries that can be used for privilege escalation.
item_advice.operator_impact: Removing these binaries requires rebuilding the image and may remove expected admin functionality.
item_advice.validation_advice: Rebuild image from minimal base, remove or replace setuid/setgid tools, and run integration tests to confirm operational needs are met.
item_advice.ordering_reason: Lower probability but medium impact; image rebuilds take more effort and should follow credential/filesystem hardening.
